test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Colossal statues of Kushana rulers have been found installed in a shrine at Mat. Which of the following is that state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttar Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Huge statues of Kushana emperors **have been discovered erected at a **sanctuary at Mat, close to Mathura (Uttar Pradesh)**.
 
• Additionally, a shrine in Afghanistan contained similar figures. This, in the opinion of some historians, shows that the Kushanas thought of themselves as divine.
 
• Many Kushana kings also took the term devaputra, which means** "son of god," **presumably as a result of Chinese emperors referring to themselves as sons of heaven.
 
• Evidence of larger nations, including the **Gupta Empire,** dates to the fourth century.
 
• Many of these were dependent on samantas, or self-sufficient men who controlled local resources like the land.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Kushanas,** who ruled over a wide kingdom spanning from Central Asia to northwest India, lived in the first century BCE or first century CE.
 
• The inscriptions and textual traditions have been used to reconstruct their history.
 
• Perhaps their coinage and art best demonstrate the ideas of kingship they intended to represent.
